title: Omnipod DASH not available in Setup Wizard on Android 15 (Samsung S25+)
body:
App version: AAPS 3.3.2.1 (also tested 3.3.2.0) 
Phone: Samsung Galaxy S25 Plus
Android version: 15

Problem:
When running the setup wizard after a clean install of AAPS (aapsclient-release APK), no pump options are shown. 
The wizard only displays "Synchronization" (NS Client V1/V3, xDrip, wear, Garmin, Samsung Tizen) and "Profile". 
After that, the wizard jumps directly to "Finish". 
This means Omnipod DASH (and other pump modules) are missing from the wizard, and I cannot configure my pump at all.

What I tried:
- Verified correct APK ("app-aapsclient-release", not client2 or pumpcontrol).
- Uninstalled old version completely before reinstall.
- Tried both v3.3.2.1 and v3.3.2.0.
- Same result: DASH not visible, only synchronization + profile + finish.
- Multiple users with Android 15 (Galaxy S25) report the same issue on Facebook.

Expected:
Omnipod DASH should appear in the wizard pump configuration step.

Actual:
No pump options appear at all.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Clean install of AAPS 3.3.2.1 (client-release APK).
2. Run setup wizard on Samsung S25+ with Android 15.
3. Only synchronization + profile shown, no pump modules, wizard ends with finish.

Additional notes:
On previous phone/Android versions, Omnipod DASH was working normally.
This looks like a bug specific to Android 15 + the current AAPS build.

Please advise if workaround or patch is available.

comments.body:
Hi! You need to build fullRelease variant in android studios of browser build. The name of that app is AAPS. See wiki. 

AAPSClient is not able to control pumps. It is the follower app.
